mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points triggers market concern about consumer spending deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp for 3 months, or Rank IC < -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in real economic activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO < 100 for 3 months) signal reduced corporate output capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC < -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when both PAYEMS and HOUST decline, or interaction effect Rank IC < -0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2% (GDPC1 > 2.0) signals robust economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.0, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3% annually for 3 months) triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3% annually for 3 months, or Rank IC < -0.02.
